messages:
anya: Quick note — onboarding Tempesta11b (int8) hit intermittent OOMs on canary when generating long responses. Seen locally on canary-4 with batch 2+ around token ~1200.

mike: OOM type? CUDA alloc or eviction failure?

anya: CUDA malloc failed. Example: '[2026-03-24 10:12:01] ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory; requested=1.05GiB, free=820MiB; stack runtime/kv_cache.c:evict_slots->alloc_chunk'

rachel: We shipped int8 with prefetch=true and default max_new_tokens=512. Prefetching large context + high max_new is increasing transient KV working set and fragmenting the allocator.

jordan: Short term mitigation: disable prefetch and reduce max_new_tokens. Set batch_size=1 for canary.

lee: Agreed. Also try compact_kv and kv_trim_on_alloc flags to force compaction during alloc.

anya: I'll run a smoke with: model=tempesta11b-int8, batch=1, max_new=256, prefetch=false, compact_kv=true, kv_trim_on_alloc=true.

ci-bot: Starting canary run canary-20260324-07 for tempesta11b-int8 (id: canary-20260324-07).

mike: If stable, change canary defaults and add a gating rule: frag stress (long prompt + batch 2..4) must pass before allowing batch>1 on int8.

rachel: Also capture eval diffs (QA/summarization) and attach to model card to justify defaults.

anya: Quick update: first 200 runs passed, 0 OOMs. Will run full 1k smoke and post metrics.

ci-bot: canary-20260324-07 completed: 1000/1000 OK, 0 OOMs, avg latency +3.1% vs baseline.

mike: Great. Action items: anya attach full eval artifacts, rachel update model card and defaults, jordan open infra ticket for fragment metrics, lee follow up on alternate quant recipes.

jordan: Filed infra ticket INF-1729 to add allocator fragmentation ratio and peak alloc gauges to canary dashboards.

anya: Closing when PR merges.
